_comment: LXM-REQ-000253: every technology the Master's tooling runs on, with the versions it supports. supported lists the versions the checks have actually run on, as version prefixes (exact evidence, LXM-REQ-000210); widening it is a gated registry change backed by a passing run on that version. probe says how the version is read: 'self' is the interpreter running the tool; a list is a command, and the first match of pattern in its output is the version. checked_at: 'gate' runtimes are checked before every gate run (the gate refuses to run outside them) and recorded in its ledger line; every runtime is checked in CI.
